universe._cap_class: small-mid, widened 2026-07-24 per real backtest evidence (see bankroll.py UNIVERSE_MAX_PRICE_TIERS). min_price here is what actually filters live discovery; max_price here only drives scripts/universe_scan.py's manual CLI tool — live discovery (discovery_scan.py/discovery_urgency_check.py) uses bankroll.universe_max_price_for_ceiling() instead, which is the real source of truth for max_price

risk._conviction_note: A sanity floor, not a real gate -- catches a broken/zero conviction score, doesn't second-guess Stan's judgment. The gestalt (world narrative + congress trades + fundamentals + wiki + cross-sectional momentum, see tick_prompt.md step 8) is where entry quality actually gets decided; a numeric conviction threshold on top of that was compounding with regime/RSI/sector gates into near-total cash idle. profit_target_is_guide and conviction_floor_min are declared here for reference; they are not dead params.
risk._trailing_stop_source: ratchets up from peak price since entry, mechanically enforced in executor.py check_stops(), not LLM-judgment. trailing_stop_mode='volatility_scaled' uses formula: trail_pct = trailing_stop_pct * (1 + trail_k * vol_20d) clamped to [trail_min_pct, trail_max_pct]. Research: 2026-07-28 trailing-stop.md — TRAIL_K=40 is best variant across all metrics (Sharpe 1.08, +126% vs no-trail), robust in both split halves.
risk._duplicate_order_source: cooldown blocks a same-ticker/same-action repeat submission without blocking legitimate cross-tick re-entries
risk._drawdown_source: competition mode's circuit breaker, measured from peak equity (state/peak_equity.json), not starting capital. Blocks new BUYs only — SELLs (including stop-losses) always pass. drawdown_halt_pct is a harder stop than pause but same BUY-only scope; see gate_drawdown_circuit_breaker.
risk._stop_patience_reverted: 2026-07-27: stop_loss_pct_max/trailing_stop_pct_max (stop_patience.py's widening-with-holding-time mechanism) were tried and reverted same day -- overnight split-window backtest (research/2026-07-27.md) found flat stops beat every patience variant tested on Sharpe and return, in both halves. stop_patience.py stays on disk (tests intact) for a future redesign, unwired from check_stops() for now.

long_play._source: 2026-07-30: small, short-horizon, evidence-gated exception to the normal trailing-stop schedule -- a long play is an explicit prediction ('ticker X up by predicted_by_date'), sized at position_size_pct (half of max_position_pct) rather than the normal size while unproven, capped at max_concurrent_long_plays so this can't quietly become the default response to every position. horizon_days starts at 3 (Raf, 2026-07-30: start with 2-3 day experiments, grow only as calibration is proven) -- bump this only after a manual review of long-play hit rate (see scripts/signal_scorecard.py), never auto-tuned. The absolute hard stop_loss_pct still applies unconditionally to long plays -- this exempts the TRAILING stop only, not the circuit breaker. Directly informed by stop_patience.py's revert (see _stop_patience_reverted above): that mechanism widened stops blindly by calendar time with zero conviction signal and lost money net; this one requires a stated, evidence-backed reason at entry and a hard resolution date instead of open-ended patience.

conviction_play._source: The conviction bucket -- well-known/liquid names Stan has actually researched (fundamentals + congress trades + wiki narrative + cross-sectional momentum, see tick_prompt.md step 8) and written a real thesis for, held until the thesis plays out or breaks rather than a mechanical exit. Sized larger than standard (position_size_pct vs max_position_pct) since these are the higher-conviction bets, not the wide/opportunistic sweep. trail_multiplier widens the normal volatility-scaled trailing stop (more room for a short-term dip that doesn't break the thesis) -- not exempted from it entirely, and the hard stop_loss_pct always applies. Deliberately not given the reverted stop_patience.py's unbounded calendar-time patience -- a wider stop, not an absent one.

risk_guards._max_positions_per_sector_source: Raised from 2 -- logs repeatedly showed 5+ sectors sitting at 0/2 with real candidates gated off, not genuine diversification protection. Still a real cap, just not one that deadlocks a wide/diverse book.
risk_guards._order_count_audit_threshold_daily_sourc: Self-imposed rogue-loop backstop (see gate_daily_order_count), not an Alpaca limit -- Alpaca's actual constraint is a 200 req/min API rate cap. 30 is a real tripwire against a stuck loop without gating a normal active 'small and wide, scale into winners' day.

bootstrap_phase._source: 2026-07-28: while bankroll.py's ceiling (start $700, cap $2000, +2%/win -1%/loss -- see recalc_ceiling) is still below ceiling_threshold, strategy.md's Exit judgment biases toward banking small, fast, clearly-positive wins over letting them run -- ceiling growth is win-COUNT-driven (is_win boolean, magnitude-blind), so more frequent small wins compound the ceiling faster while capital is small. Fades out once ceiling crosses the threshold, reverting to the normal profit_target_pct-is-a-guide/let-winners-run judgment. Checked via trader_query.py bankroll's ceiling field, not lifetime_trades (see git log params.json for why).

watchlist._eval_batch_size_source: 2026-07-28: stonks-tick cron (280s budget) blew its timeout evaluating the full watchlist every tick in step 8 -- trader_query.py watchlist --batch N + trader_write.py watchlist-mark-evaluated round-robin through idle_ticks (see trader_db.get_watchlist_batch/increment_idle_ticks) instead. 6 keeps a full rotation well under idle_ticks_before_drop at current list sizes (~31 candidates -> ~5-tick cycle).

discovery_urgency._source: scripts/discovery_urgency_check.py — cash_threshold_pct+min_candidates gate the cash-thin/thin-pipeline AND trigger (checked by the 45-min stonks-discovery-urgent cron); empty_floor is the cash-independent OR trigger, checked every tick via tick_prompt.md step 7 when the Candidates section looks empty

synthesis._source: Tuned for live-only journal cadence (~1 entry/trading day). Once the historical-replay harness lands and adds many more journal entries per week, revisit this number with real replay-volume data rather than guessing -- don't raise it preemptively with no data to calibrate against.

discovery_daemon._source: 2026-07-27: scripts/discovery_daemon.py (a real systemd-supervised background process, deploy/stonks-discovery-daemon.service -- not another OpenClaw cron, this repo's one deliberate exception) reads chunk_size/*_interval_seconds/finbert_confirm_*; scripts/promote_candidates.py (called every tick from tick_prompt.md step 7) reads promote_top_n/promote_max_age_seconds; scripts/discovery_urgency_check.py reads daemon_health_stale_multiplier via discovery_daemon.daemon_health() to flag the daemon unhealthy in its output (informational only, does not change its own trigger logic -- stays armed as defense-in-depth if the daemon ever dies). Standalone: zero dependency on data_bus.py (see skills/data-bus-fallback.md). Pool lives in state/discovery_pool.db, never touched by anything but discovery_daemon.py (writer) and promote_candidates.py (reader).

local_db._source: scripts/trader_db.py (schema/CRUD) + scripts/db_writer.py (write-behind buffer, flushed synchronously at end-of-tick) read path/max_batch_size. alpaca_audit_retention_days bounds scripts/alpaca_audit.py's table growth. Local SQLite, not docker.klo Postgres -- schema kept plain/portable in case of a later migration.

guardrail_gates._note: each gate is true (hard block), false (disabled, doesn't run), or "warn" (runs and its result is visible in check_order's gate_results, but never blocks the trade -- see check_order() in executor.py). Use warn for gates whose right threshold isn't known yet -- it surfaces how often the gate would have fired, real data instead of a guessed number, without losing the trade in the meantime. scripts/executor.py reads this every run. Per-gate rationale lives in git history (git log -p params.json), not here.
guardrail_gates._max_positions_note: 2026-07-30: intentionally disabled, not a bug -- no fixed position-count cap wanted. Portfolio-level risk is already bounded by max_portfolio_risk/max_position_pct/sector_concentration/bankroll, so an additional raw position-count ceiling isn't needed. Do not re-enable without an explicit decision to add one back.
